title: Astronomy Shop · 日志与调用链

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT service_name FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE "resource_attributes.service.namespace" = 'opentelemetry-demo' ORDER BY service_name

options.content:
按服务、级别和文本搜索日志。输入 Trace ID 后，显示该调用链的 spans 和关联日志；Trace ID 为空时，瀑布图不加载。

[从慢请求选择 Trace ID](/d/astronomy-services-zh)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_bin(INTERVAL '1 minute', "timestamp") AS time, CASE WHEN severity_number >= 21 THEN 'FATAL' WHEN severity_number >= 17 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN severity_number >= 13 THEN 'WARN' WHEN severity_number >= 9 THEN 'INFO' WHEN severity_number >= 5 THEN 'DEBUG' WHEN severity_number >= 1 THEN 'TRACE' ELSE 'UNSPECIFIED' END AS level, COUNT(*) AS lines FROM opentelemetry_logs WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, '["service.namespace"]') = 'opentelemetry-demo' AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, '["service.name"]') IN (${service:sqlstring}) AND (${level:sqlstring} = 'All' OR (CASE WHEN severity_number >= 21 THEN 'FATAL' WHEN severity_number >= 17 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN severity_number >= 13 THEN 'WARN' WHEN severity_number >= 9 THEN 'INFO' WHEN severity_number >= 5 THEN 'DEBUG' WHEN severity_number >= 1 THEN 'TRACE' ELSE 'UNSPECIFIED' END) = ${level:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR strpos(lower(body), lower(${search:sqlstring})) > 0) AND (${trace_id:sqlstring} = '' OR trace_id = ${trace_id:sqlstring}) GROUP BY time, level ORDER BY time

SELECT "timestamp" AS timestamp, body, CASE WHEN severity_number >= 21 THEN 'FATAL' WHEN severity_number >= 17 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN severity_number >= 13 THEN 'WARN' WHEN severity_number >= 9 THEN 'INFO' WHEN severity_number >= 5 THEN 'DEBUG' WHEN severity_number >= 1 THEN 'TRACE' ELSE 'UNSPECIFIED' END AS level, json_get_string(resource_attributes, '["service.name"]') AS service_name, trace_id FROM opentelemetry_logs WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, '["service.namespace"]') = 'opentelemetry-demo' AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, '["service.name"]') IN (${service:sqlstring}) AND (${level:sqlstring} = 'All' OR (CASE WHEN severity_number >= 21 THEN 'FATAL' WHEN severity_number >= 17 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN severity_number >= 13 THEN 'WARN' WHEN severity_number >= 9 THEN 'INFO' WHEN severity_number >= 5 THEN 'DEBUG' WHEN severity_number >= 1 THEN 'TRACE' ELSE 'UNSPECIFIED' END) = ${level:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR strpos(lower(body), lower(${search:sqlstring})) > 0) AND (${trace_id:sqlstring} = '' OR trace_id = ${trace_id:sqlstring}) ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 200

panels.title: 日志中的 Trace 链接

targets.rawSql: SELECT "timestamp" AS timestamp, body, CASE WHEN severity_number >= 21 THEN 'FATAL' WHEN severity_number >= 17 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN severity_number >= 13 THEN 'WARN' WHEN severity_number >= 9 THEN 'INFO' WHEN severity_number >= 5 THEN 'DEBUG' WHEN severity_number >= 1 THEN 'TRACE' ELSE 'UNSPECIFIED' END AS level, json_get_string(resource_attributes, '["service.name"]') AS service_name, trace_id FROM opentelemetry_logs WHERE $__timeFilter("timestamp") AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, '["service.namespace"]') = 'opentelemetry-demo' AND json_get_string(resource_attributes, '["service.name"]') IN (${service:sqlstring}) AND (${level:sqlstring} = 'All' OR (CASE WHEN severity_number >= 21 THEN 'FATAL' WHEN severity_number >= 17 THEN 'ERROR' WHEN severity_number >= 13 THEN 'WARN' WHEN severity_number >= 9 THEN 'INFO' WHEN severity_number >= 5 THEN 'DEBUG' WHEN severity_number >= 1 THEN 'TRACE' ELSE 'UNSPECIFIED' END) = ${level:sqlstring}) AND (${search:sqlstring} = '' OR strpos(lower(body), lower(${search:sqlstring})) > 0) AND (${trace_id:sqlstring} = '' OR trace_id = ${trace_id:sqlstring}) AND trace_id IS NOT NULL AND trace_id <> '' ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC LIMIT 200

targets.rawSql: SELECT * FROM opentelemetry_traces WHERE trace_id <> '' AND trace_id = ${trace_id:sqlstring} ORDER BY "timestamp"

panels.description: 按 Trace ID 加载全部已存储的 spans，不受大盘时间范围限制。
